iam-root-account-used-recently.description: Root account used in the last 30 days
iam-root-account-used-recently.rationale: Root account should only be used to bootstrap the environment. Use IAM users with minimum privilege instead.
iam-root-account-used-recently.remediation: Avoid direct root usage. Create admin IAM users and rotate access keys.

iam-user-with-password-and-no-mfa.description: IAM user with password login and without MFA enabled
iam-user-with-password-and-no-mfa.rationale: MFA reduces risk of account compromise.
iam-user-with-password-and-no-mfa.remediation: Enable hardware or virtual MFA device per user.

iam-user-with-multiple-access-keys.description: IAM user with more than one active access key
iam-user-with-multiple-access-keys.rationale: Multiple active keys complicate rotation and incident response.
iam-user-with-multiple-access-keys.remediation: Keep at most one active key and rotate every 90 days.

cloudtrail-no-global-trail.rationale: Without multi-region trail, cross-region actions are not audited.
cloudtrail-no-global-trail.remediation: Enable a multi-region CloudTrail covering all event types.
